response.answer:
The Construction Management Bachelor of Technology is a degree-completion program offered in person at the Burnaby campus, full-time or part-time.

To qualify, you must complete a departmental pre-entry assessment, have English Studies 12 at 73% or equivalent, and meet **one** of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma/degree with at least 67% GPA plus one year of construction experience.
- Unrelated diploma/degree and the BCIT Construction Operations Associate Certificate, both with at least 67%, plus one year of experience.
- Unrelated diploma/degree with at least 67% plus eight years of North American construction-management experience in mid/senior roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, accepted math at 60%, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at 67%, and one additional year of industry experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

Your education, grades, and experience are still needed to assess which pathway you meet. Start with the departmental pre-entry assessment and review the application information here: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/

The Construction Management Bachelor of Technology is a degree-completion program offered in person at the Burnaby campus, full-time or part-time.

To qualify, you must complete a departmental pre-entry assessment, have English Studies 12 at 73% or equivalent, and meet **one** of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma/degree with at least 67% GPA plus one year of construction experience.

- Unrelated diploma/degree with at least 67% plus eight years of North American construction-management experience in mid/senior roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, accepted math at 60%, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at 67%, and one additional year of industry experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

conversation.content: I want to apply to Construction Management Bachelor of Technology.

The Construction Management Bachelor of Technology is a degree-completion program offered in person at the Burnaby campus, full-time or part-time.

To qualify, you must complete a departmental pre-entry assessment, have English Studies 12 at 73% or equivalent, and meet **one** of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma/degree with at least 67% GPA plus one year of construction experience.

- Unrelated diploma/degree with at least 67% plus eight years of North American construction-management experience in mid/senior roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, accepted math at 60%, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at 67%, and one additional year of industry experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

User: I want to apply to Construction Management Bachelor of Technology.
Assistant: The Construction Management Bachelor of Technology is a degree-completion program offered in person at the Burnaby campus, full-time or part-time.

To qualify, you must complete a departmental pre-entry assessment, have English Studies 12 at 73% or equivalent, and meet **one** of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma/degree with at least 67% GPA plus one year of construction experience.
- Unrelated diploma/degree and the BCIT Construction Operations Associate Certificate, both with at least 67%, plus one year of experience.
- Unrelated diploma/degree with at least 67% plus eight years of North American construction-management experience in mid/senior roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, accepted math at 60%, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at 67%, and one additional year of industry experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

Assistant: Potentially—but the Civil Engineering diploma alone is not enough.

- At least **one year of construction-industry work experience**
- **English Studies 12 at 73%** or equivalent
- An approved **departmental pre-entry assessment** before applying

If your diploma was earned outside Canada, the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, or New Zealand, a course-by-course credential evaluation and GPA calculation is also required.

Your next step is to confirm your GPA and construction-work experience through the pre-entry assessment: https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/

Besides your Civil Engineering diploma, the remaining admission conditions are:

- A minimum **67% diploma GPA**
- At least **one year of construction-industry work experience**
- **English Studies 12 at 73%** or an accepted equivalent
- An approved **departmental pre-entry assessment** before applying

The department must confirm that your diploma is construction-related and from a recognized institution. If it was earned outside Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, or New Zealand, you also need an accepted course-by-course credential evaluation and GPA calculation.

Your next step is to submit the pre-entry assessment with your GPA and work-experience details:  
https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/
